introHtml: Pink personal protection equipment adds a distinctive, visible layer of safety for workplaces, events, or fundraising campaigns. Whether you're outfitting a breast cancer awareness walk or simply want high-visibility PPE that stands out, pink gear offers both function and a memorable look. Decorate with screen printing or embroidery for a custom finish your crew will appreciate.
